claims.assertion: Yazhi describes tulpas and ordinary reality alike as ideas sustained through perception and shared agreements.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as her own metaphysical view.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says ideas and entities formed through experience can carry across incarnations or between density levels.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She includes both positive and negative ideas in this account.

review_flags: The interview presents metaphysical claims about reality, tulpas, and reincarnation without independent verification.
coverage_gaps: The discussion also distinguishes the Source from ideas and explores negative entities.
